plan.summary: Delete 27 poisoned aggregator-archive caches that the new containing-title guard (BRO-4953) flags: each is a roundup for a different show whose title contains the target's (The Heart of Rock and Roll for The Heart, Fun Home for Home, Once Upon a Mattress for Once, ...). Built from data/audit/aggregator-archive-integrity.json (reason containing-title-sibling), not hand-listed. Without this, check-corpus-drift's --strict integrity audit alerts daily until a scraper happens to re-read each file. Part 2 of 2 (MAX_PLAN_ACTIONS is 25).
